API ReferenceZscaler Cloud & Branch Connector APIProvisioningGet Public Account Details
Get Public Account Details
GET
https://api.zsapi.net/ztw/api/v1/publicCloudAccountDetails

Lists public cloud account information.

Request
​
QUERY PARAMETERS
page
int32

Specifies the page offset.

Default value: 1
pageSize
int32

Specifies the page size. The default size is 250.

Default value: 250
Responses
​
default

Default Response. See API Response Codes

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
SCHEMA
Array [
id
int32

Internal ID of public cloud account/subscription.

accountId
string

Account or subscription ID of public cloud account.

platformId
string

Public cloud platform (AWS or Azure).

Possible values: [AWS, AZURE]

]
